podcast.title: Label for Teenage Jesus and the Jerks (1978)
podcast.body: Migraine Records released music by the No Wave band Teenage Jesus and the Jerks in 1978, serving as a platform for their dissonant and artsy sound from New York City. "This was released in 1978 on a label called Migraine Records."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: No Wave Release Label
podcast.body: Migraine was the label responsible for releasing "Burning Rubber" by Teenage Jesus and the Jerks in 1979, an example of No Wave music. "And oh, look at this, it came out in a label called Migraine."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
